## Problem

A clear description of the problem. **What need does this solve?**

Example: "I keep having to add the same folder to the ignore list manually..."

## Proposed solution

Describe how you'd like it to work. UI sketch or mockup is very welcome.

## Alignment with project goals

SentinelScan is:
- Single file
- Standard library only
- Offline by design
- Windows / macOS / Linux

How does your feature fit these constraints?

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Anything else — screenshots, examples from other tools, etc.
